newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle rather slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle rather slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry and demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 1700 slaughter steers and 2000 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 93,300 head confirmed, including 14100 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 66.00, pen 1300 lbs 65.50. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1160 lbs 66.00.
Confirmed - 3,700 last week - 900 last year - none
Wk to date - 93,300 last week - 80,800 last year - 64,600
